svg.title: A grid of 100 small squares, 10 across, where each square is one mark titled "Where the marks come from in this unit".
svg.desc: A grid of 100 small squares, 10 across, where each square is one mark. Filled from the top left, going left to right then down, one category after another in the order listed in the key. Practical observation: 50 of 100 marks, which is 50 per cent. Two observed sessions in the simulated workplace, 25 marks each. Portfolio of evidence: 30 of 100 marks, which is 30 per cent. Submitted in week 10. Marked against the four criteria in the rubric. Knowledge quiz: 20 of 100 marks, which is 20 per cent. Week 6, in class, open book.
svg.text: Where the marks come from in this unit
One hundred squares, one hundred marks. Count them.

g.text: Two observed sessions in the simulated workplace, 25 marks each.
Submitted in week 10. Marked against the four criteria in the rubric.

svg.text: Half the marks are in the practical, so a strong portfolio cannot rescue a missed observation. Note also that the quiz alone will not carry you to the 50 marks needed to pass.

g.text: Source: Example weighting for layout review. Replace with the weighting in your own unit guide before publishing.
